exposure: Age group (infants 5-8 weeks old vs. children 12-23 months old)
Number of children under five in the household
cohort: Infants (n=999) aged 5-8 weeks old and children (n=1010) aged 12-23 months old in Lao People's Democratic Republic
finding: Several factors were associated with pneumococcal carriage and density, including age, household size, URTI symptoms, breastfeeding, and delivery by Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Delivery by Cesarean section was associated with higher mean pneumococcal density in pneumococcal carriers.
